description: Prevents eSpeak NG in NVDA 2026.3+ from reading unhandled raw emoji and symbols as "letter XXXX" during normal reading, while preserving character-by-character navigation and speaking CLDR names in the Windows Emoji Panel and for standalone-emoji controls.
changelog:
Initial release:
- Silences unhandled raw characters in eSpeak NG's emoji/symbol ranges during normal reading in NVDA 2026.3+.
- Speaks CLDR names for standalone emoji controls (such as the Windows Win+. Emoji Panel) even when Unicode Consortium data is disabled.
- Preserves character-by-character navigation and Persian/Arabic ZWNJ/ZWJ characters.
